sentences.en: This dog is more attached to us than this cat.
sentences.zh: 这只狗比那只猫更喜欢我们。

sentences.en: I am very much attached to this old straw hat.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢这顶旧草帽。

sentences.en: He assures us that he didn't attach a false statement.
sentences.zh: 他保证说他没有附加虚假声明。

senses.zh: 贴上，系,附上vt.（有时不受欢迎或未受邀请而）参加,把…固定,把…归因于,（使）与…有联系vi.从属,附着,伴随而来,联在一起(to, upon)
